openQuestions.question: Does boarding cost anything besides the wait and the ride (fare, cooldown, Trail, Alert exposure at watched stations)?
openQuestions.why: GDD §02 says time only; any other cost is undecided.

openQuestions.question: Are there limits on who may ride (wanted persons, armed cells, injured members)?
openQuestions.why: The GDD states none; none is assumed.

openQuestions.question: Is the 1.4 m/s interchange walk pace [S] acceptable, and is the wait for the next service after each change counted when pricing an order?
openQuestions.why: The GDD states no walking pace; journey totals exclude the wait at each change.

notes: T1 speed 8 m/s: street-running double track, stops 300-500 m apart, so a run is about 39 s. Dwell 15 s, headway 120 s [S].
T2 speed 8 m/s: street running with 50 m radius bends. It is the longest line (2.4 km), so it keeps the same values as T1: dwell 15 s, headway 120 s [S].
S1 speed 12 m/s: elevated at 24 m, faster than trams. Dwell 12 s, headway 90 s [S].
The previous S2 line and the T1/records–S2/market interchange are not in this plan, so they are removed. Lines are now T1, T2 and S1.
Interchange pairs used: T1/circus–S1/circus (about 119 m), T2/harbour–S1/harbour (about 41 m) and T1/comet–T2/comet (about 71 m). All are within the 150 m standard.
Journeys cover each pair in both directions, a three-leg trip across all three lines, and single-line end-to-end rides.
Fares, cooldowns and rider limits are not decided and are not invented here. The plan's scale and loop questions belong to Datum.
